adapter: Reticulum constructor captured, so no real node startup, configuration persistence or network evidence.

cases.stdout:
usage: rnir [-h] [--config CONFIG] [-v] [-q] [--version]

Reticulum Distributed Identity Resolver

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG  path to alternative Reticulum config directory
  -v, --verbose
  -q, --quiet
  --version        show program's version number and exit

cases.stderr:
usage: rnir [-h] [--config CONFIG] [-v] [-q] [--version]
rnir: error: unrecognized arguments: install example

cases.stdout:
usage: rnpkg [-h] [--config CONFIG] [-v] [-q] [--exampleconfig] [--version]

Reticulum Meta Package Manager

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG  path to alternative Reticulum config directory
  -v, --verbose
  -q, --quiet
  --exampleconfig  print verbose configuration example to stdout and exit
  --version        show program's version number and exit

cases.stderr:
usage: rnpkg [-h] [--config CONFIG] [-v] [-q] [--exampleconfig] [--version]
rnpkg: error: unrecognized arguments: install example

cases.stdout: # This is an example package manager configuration file.
